claims.claim: John of Damascus was an Eastern Christian monk, priest and theologian who lived circa 675–749 and served as chief financial officer (protosymboulus) for the Syrian caliph before becoming a monk at Mar Saba.
The treatise De unione (On Union) is a Greek work by John of Damascus that discusses the theological concept of union of divine and human natures.

In De unione John explicitly refutes the teachings of Eutyches, Dioscorus, Nestorius and other heretical positions, defending the orthodox formula of two perfect natures united in one subsistence without confusion or change.
